versions.subject: Create av_printernightmare_cve_2021_1675.yml
versions.detection:
selection_path:
    FileName|contains:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\'
selection_malware:
    FileName|endswith:
        - '.dll'
        - '.exe'
condition: selection_path and selection_malware
